characters.name: Gonegi
characters.visual_dna: [Gonegi (고네기)] Core Identity: Soulful and determined 11yo boy. 164cm. [Relational Anchor: Gamja is always nearby at his side or at his feet]. 1:6.5 slender ratio with a slightly larger head to maximize facial expression density. Face & Eyes: Mature and refined Pazu-lookalike. Eyes: Classic Ghibli shape with deep, large expressive pupils and a single, sharp crystalline highlight (#FFFFF0). Hair: Messy matte jet-black hair. Skin: Healthy sun-kissed tan (#F2D1B3). Outfit: Off-white henley shirt (sleeves rolled up), High-waisted deep navy-blue trousers (#000080), and Dark umber-brown suspenders. Footwear: Simple dark brown worn leather work boots. Protagonist Aura, expressive eyes.

characters.name: Dana
characters.visual_dna: [Dana (다나)] Core Identity: Pure, nostalgic, and airy 11yo girl. 152cm. [Relational Anchor: Aengdu is always nearby, sitting by her side or peering from behind her]. 1:6.3 slender ratio. Face & Eyes: Mature but soft facial structure. Eyes: Large, clear oceanic blue (#2E5894) with a look of longing. Hair: Long flowing soft chestnut hair (#8B5A2B) in low twin ponytails tied with thin blue strings. Skin: Fair and clear complexion with sharp-edged lavender-tinted shadows (#967BB6). Outfit: One-piece sleeveless shift dress in Solid Pale Cornflower Blue (#ABCDEF). Accessory: Single small seashell pendant. Footwear: Simple flat dark-brown leather sandals (thin straps). Protagonist Aura, expressive eyes.
